```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r read dataset}
file_path <- "or130-rwl-noaa.txt"
df <- read_tsv(file_path, comment = "#", na = c("NA"))
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r data cleaning}
year_col <- "age_CE"
tree_cols <- setdiff(names(df), year_col)

# create the outlier_flag column to label outliers
df_with_flags <- df

for (tree in tree_cols) {
  x <- df[[tree]]
  z <- (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  flag_col <- paste0(tree, "_outlier_flag")
  df_with_flags[[flag_col]] <- ifelse(is.na(z), NA, abs(z) > 3)
}

tree_summary <- data.frame(tree = tree_cols)

# year range
year_min <- min(df[[year_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
year_max <- max(df[[year_col]], na.rm = TRUE)

# create columms of missing values count
for (tree in tree_cols) {
  df_tree <- df_with_flags %>% select(all_of(year_col), all_of(tree))
  non_missing <- df_tree %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[tree]]))

  observed_years <- non_missing[[year_col]]
  last_sample_year <- max(observed_years, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  all_years <- seq(year_min, last_sample_year)
  focus_years <- seq(1980, last_sample_year)
  
  missing_total <- length(setdiff(all_years, observed_years))
  missing_focus <- length(setdiff(focus_years, observed_years))
  
  outlier_col <- paste0(tree, "_outlier_flag")
  n_outliers <- sum(df_with_flags[[outlier_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  tree_summary[tree_summary$tree == tree, "n_missing_total"] <- missing_total
  tree_summary[tree_summary$tree == tree, "n_missing_1980_on"] <- missing_focus
  tree_summary[tree_summary$tree == tree, "n_outliers_total"] <- n_outliers
}

# save the result
 #write_csv(df_with_flags, "cleaned_tree_data_with_flags.csv")
 #write_csv(tree_summary, "tree_quality_summary.csv")

print(head(df_with_flags))
print(tree_summary)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
